action:
After a standard system update you need to restart any running Java
applications to make all the necessary changes.
description:
Albert Yang and Quang Luong discovered that the Compiler component of
OpenJDK 25 did not correctly handle certain inputs. A remote attacker could
possibly use this issue to cause a denial of service or execute arbitrary
code. (CVE-2026-114938)

It was discovered that the JGSS component of OpenJDK 25 did not correctly
authenticate users. A remote attacker could possibly use this issue to read
or modify sensitive data. (CVE-2026-114939)

Nicholas Carlini discovered that the JSSE component of OpenJDK 25 did not
correctly authorize users. A remote attacker could possibly use this issue
to read or modify sensitive data. (CVE-2026-114940)

It was discovered that the Compiler component of OpenJDK 25 did not
correctly authorize users. A remote attacker could possibly use this issue
to cause a denial of service or to read or modify sensitive data.
(CVE-2026-114941)

It was discovered that the Libraries component of OpenJDK 25 did not
correctly authorize users. A remote attacker could possibly use this issue
to cause a denial of service or to read or modify sensitive data.
(CVE-2026-114942)

It was discovered that the Hotspot component of OpenJDK 25 did not
correctly authorize users. A remote attacker could possibly use this issue
to cause a denial of service or to modify sensitive data. (CVE-2026-114943)

Alexander Dezhinov, Stanislav Dukhin, Nikita Kozlov, and Binbin Xu
discovered that the Core Java Libraries component of OpenJDK 25 did not
correctly authorize users. A remote attacker could possibly use this issue
to modify sensitive data. (CVE-2026-114944)

It was discovered that the Libraries component of OpenJDK 25 did not
correctly authorize users. A remote attacker could possibly use this issue
to modify sensitive data. (CVE-2026-114945)

It was discovered that the Compiler component of OpenJDK 25 did not
correctly authorize users. A remote attacker could possibly use this issue
to read or modify sensitive data. (CVE-2026-114946)

Juraj Somorovsky, Maximilian Radoy, and Sven Hebrok discovered that the
JSSE component of OpenJDK 25 did not correctly authorize users. A remote
attacker could possibly use this issue to modify sensitive data.
(CVE-2026-114947)

Please see the following for more information:
https://openjdk.org/groups/vulnerability/advisories/2026-11-17
isummary: Several security issues were fixed in OpenJDK 25.
title: OpenJDK 25 vulnerabilities
